turns.text: Counting contiguous subarrays that sum to k. First question: can the array contain negative numbers?

Then a sliding window is out — with negatives the running sum isn't monotonic, so there's no valid shrink condition. I'll go with prefix sums in a hash map: for each running sum, count how many earlier prefixes equal running - k.

One detail I want to get right is seeding the map with {0: 1}. That entry stands for the empty prefix, and it's what lets a subarray starting at index 0 be counted. No more questions, I'm ready to start coding.
All passing, including the all-zeros case, which is the one I'd expect to break a naive version — it wants 6, not 3, because overlapping subarrays each count. I'm satisfied with this — let's move on.
O(n) time, single pass with O(1) expected work per element. O(n) space for the prefix-count map, since in the worst case every prefix sum is distinct.
